title: Amadeus Flight Offers API Reference

raw_data.description: Returns available airline offers for given dates, origin, destination, and passenger parameters with real-time seat inventory.

query_parameters.originLocationCode: 3-letter IATA code of origin airport (e.g. BOM)
query_parameters.destinationLocationCode: 3-letter IATA code of destination airport (e.g. DXB)
query_parameters.nonStop: true/false boolean filter for direct flights

response_structure.data: List of flight offers with unique offer IDs
response_structure.itineraries: Flight segments, durations, and operating carriers
response_structure.price: Currency, total, and base fare amounts
response_structure.travelerPricings: Fare details and baggage allowances per passenger
